basic.description:
{Basic Mysticism}

Basic Mysticism allows your hero to regenerate 5 spell points or 10% of the maximum spell points per day (whichever is higher).

advanced.description:
{Advanced Mysticism}

Advanced Mysticism allows your hero to regenerate 10 spell points or 20% of the maximum spell points per day (whichever is higher).

expert.description:
{Expert Mysticism}

Expert Mysticism allows your hero to regenerate 15 spell points or 30% of the maximum spell points per day (whichever is higher).
